Subject: Implementation and evidence for No-Model-Learning opt-out

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. One outstanding legal ask before we proceed to pilot: we need a firm operational commitment and evidence that MedPolicy data will not be used to improve models (no adaptive training / no learning). Specifically the legal team would like:

- A short, machine-readable statement we can reference in the DPA and SOW that describes the technical control (toggle/flag + routing) used to prevent learning.
- An evidence pack showing how requests are processed (logs/audit), where KV/prefix caches live, and proof of onshore routing for US-bound data.
- A sample attestation we can sign quarterly.
- Confirmation that subprocessors which process inference payloads are onshore or covered by contractual controls; example concerned party: CloudX Storage.

Can you share a timeline for providing these items? We need something internal to show legal by EOD next Thursday (2028-03-16).

Best,
Claire

Claire — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and can deliver; below is a concise plan and schedule. I'll loop in Legal Ops (Kimberly) and Privacy (David) for the attestation and subprocessor confirmation.

Summary of controls (short statement you can reference in the DPA):
Redwood will process MedPolicy Labs inference requests under an operational No-Model-Learning mode: inference payloads are handled on isolated serving pools with the model-improvement flag disabled, KV/prefix caches are ephemeral and scoped per-tenant, and telemetry used for service health is stripped of content-level inputs. No customer interaction data will be included in model training datasets.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Day 1 (today): Ops checklist (PDF) and evidence matrix (excel) — initial versions attached.
- Day 3 (2028-03-12): Technical runbook describing toggle implementation, routing policies (onshore routing for US), and KV/cache lifecycle, plus a sanitized log sample.
- Day 5 (2028-03-14): Draft quarterly attestation template for legal review.
- Day 7 (2028-03-16): Finalized evidence pack and legal-friendly statement for insertion into the DPA/SOW.

Subprocessor note:
We use a small set of subprocessors for storage and observability. CloudX Storage is currently a read-replica for archived telemetry (no oracle of raw payloads) for customers that have chosen their managed S3. For MedPolicy workload we can: (a) disable CloudX routing entirely and use our on-prem SFTP or AWS-managed buckets in us-east-1, or (b) add contractual constraints and monthly attestations. Kimberly — can you confirm contract language and whether we should propose option (a) as default?

Attachments: optout-ops-checklist.pdf, evidence-matrix.xlsx

Let me know if you'd like a short walkthrough call later today.

—Aditya

Claire — attaching the sanitized log example and the attestation template per your asks. Answers inline below.

1) Sanitized log example: attached as a single row CSV in the evidence matrix and also pasted below for convenience. Redaction occurs at the ingestion layer (edge proxy) where PII and content fields are tokenized/masked before hitting telemetry pipelines. Example sanitized entry:

"2028-03-09T14:30:12Z, request_id=abcd1234, tenant=medpolicy, route=us-east-1, latency_ms=21, model=redwood-std-v2, content_present=false, retention_flag=ephemeral"

2) Option (a) cost/throughput impact: Using our AWS-managed buckets in us-east-1 (default for MedPolicy) adds no additional per-request latency and a negligible monthly storage delta (estimate attached in evidence-matrix.xlsx). We can provide an EBS-backed cache to maintain throughput parity if you need >1000 TPS sustained; that would be an architectural add-on with a predictable commit.

3) Ops contact & attestation flow: Ops contact: David Kim (david_kim@redwood.ai). He will be the point of contact for monthly attestations. DocuSign flow: we propose Redwood signs a quarterly attestation which is then countersigned by MedPolicy — draft DocuSign workflow link: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/ABC-Optout-MP (draft).

Next steps:
- Kimberley/Kimberly: please confirm subprocessor language we should propose (I recommended disabling CloudX for this account by default).
- I'll prepare the final DPA-ready paragraph and SOW insertion for your legal team by 2028-03-16.

Attachments: attestation-template.docx, evidence-matrix.xlsx (sanitized sample tab)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that speeds up review.
